subject: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter and SIG/CAIQ for Nimbus renewal
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@nimbusfin.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal packet — SOC2, SIG and timeline request

Hi Monica / Lauren,

As discussed on the call yesterday, Nimbus Finance is beginning our security review ahead of the July 15 renewal. Procurement needs the following to complete the contract and internal approvals: 

- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (full report) and any bridge letter if the report period does not cover our required audit window
- Completed SIG questionnaire or CAIQ
- Confirmation of audit period dates (report start/end and whether controls have changed since end date)
- Point of contact for evidence requests (control owners)

Attached is our procurement checklist to fill in (Nimbus_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). We need these materials by 2026-07-05 to allow legal and security review before the July 15 renewal. If you anticipate any gaps, please flag them and provide an estimated date for a bridge letter or interim confirmation.

Tom (our CISO) is copied to confirm scope. If you prefer to upload to the shared Drive link or send a DocuSign-secured file, let us know.

Thanks,
Elena
Procurement Manager
Nimbus Finance
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@nimbusfin.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal packet — SOC2, SIG and timeline request

Hi Elena — thanks for the checklist and the clear timeline. We can support this and will provide: 

- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (Type II report covering audit period shown inside the PDF)
- A signed bridge letter confirming there have been no material control changes since the report period, if needed (we can provide by 2026-07-02)
- Completed SIG/CAIQ workbook (we'll return the populated CAIQ and a signed SIG attestation)

Quick clarification: what exact audit-period coverage does Nimbus require? Our most recent Type II report covers 2024-05-01 through 2025-04-30. If you need coverage through mid-2026, we will supply a bridge letter that explicitly states control continuity and any compensating controls.

Proposed next steps:
1) We will upload the SOC2 PDF and SIG/CAIQ draft to the Drive link and send a DocuSign copy for signature by 2026-07-02.
2) If you need additional evidence (policies, config screenshots, or test results), please identify which controls you want sampled by 2026-07-05.

CC'ing Lauren to route to our compliance team for the bridge letter and any evidence pulls. Deal/hubspot reference is helpful if you want us to attach to the record.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@nimbusfin.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Baker <tom.baker@nimbusfin.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@nimbusfin.com>
Date: 2026-06-26T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal packet — SOC2, SIG and timeline request

Thanks Monica. Apologies — I should have included the audit window in the original note. For our internal compliance sign-off we need evidence that covers at minimum 2025-05-01 through 2026-04-30 (our fiscal audit window). If Redwood's Type II report period ends 2025-04-30, a bridge letter that confirms no material control changes from 2025-05-01 through 2026-06-30 will be acceptable, and the letter should state what evidence is available for that timeframe (e.g., monitoring logs, change control summaries).

Please also indicate whether the SIG/CAIQ will be signed by your security lead or provided as a completed workbook. We prefer both: workbook + signed attestation.

We have uploaded a version of our procurement checklist with required documentation types for each line item — I attached it as procurement_checklist_filled.pdf for your convenience.

Elena
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-26T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal packet — SOC2, SIG and timeline request

Karthik — forwarding Nimbus' checklist and timeline. Key asks: provide the SOC2 Type II (attached above in my reply), produce a bridge letter that covers 2025-05-01 through 2026-06-30, and complete the SIG/CAIQ workbook with signed attestation. They need materials by 2026-07-05; bridge letter preferred by 2026-07-02.

Specific items they flagged:
- Explicit statement in the bridge letter about unchanged control environment since 2025-04-30
- List of available evidence for the bridge period (logs, change control, incident summaries)
- Populated CAIQ workbook + signed attestation from our security lead

Can you confirm owners for each deliverable and whether we need additional time to pull sampled evidence? Also confirm what we will upload to the Drive versus what we will send via DocuSign. HubSpot deal is NIM-2026-07-01 (link below) — please attach final artifacts to the deal when ready.

Thanks — Monica
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T15:40:00-07:00

Monica / Lauren — confirming the compliance plan and timeline: 

- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf: ready to share (we will upload to the shared Drive and push a DocuSign-secured copy to Nimbus).
- SOC2_Bridge_20260702.pdf: signed bridge letter drafted and signed by our Head of Security. The letter states that there were no material changes to the control environment from 2025-05-01 through 2026-06-30 and lists available evidence types (monitoring logs retention, change control records, incident postmortems).
- Redwood_SIG-CAIQ_2026.xlsx: CAIQ workbook is completed and signed; we will provide both the populated sheet and a signed attestation PDF.

Uploads and links: we will upload all artifacts to the Drive folder and paste the DocuSign link to the HubSpot deal by end of day 2026-07-02. If Nimbus requires sample artifacts (e.g., a specific change-control pull or logs for particular dates), please specify which controls/IDs and we will prioritize extraction.

I will copy the Drive and DocuSign links once the upload is complete.

Thanks,

Redwood Inference
